scope: Independent read-only replay on test-env. No launch, input or Kindle use during the audit.
origin: Host CLOCK_MONOTONIC immediately before Popen. The child entry is a separate lifecycle observation.
normal_launch: Onboarded synthetic offline profile with stored launch=shelf; no --screen, --demo, scripted actions, --performance-trace or --ui-trace in the timed executable arguments.
input_evidence: One synthetic primary button down/up from the observer in each private Xvfb; same process, topmost target, focus, server button mask transitions, closed state before, distinct menu pixels afterward and final open-menu state checked. No in-app handling timestamp.
endpoint: Upper bound: first exact menu-response crop in the owned window corroborated by the root crop. The stable later confirmation is not the endpoint; no cover-completion or physical-display timing.

audit_delivery.visual_runner_source_difference: Only its opening module documentation string was expanded after execution; all following source text agreed.

rejected_in_memory_counterexamples: foreign or unconfirmed topmost click target
pre-click crop substituted for a response
closed final menu despite a reported visible response
response appears during the no-input control
missing-cover control still has ten resident covers
accepted_in_memory_missing_secondary_obs: Removing one case's loading observations and prior non-Shelf miss retained all six primary samples; the feedback count became five and that case's Shelf lower bound fell back to the host launch origin.
